import {Audit} from './web-tools/node_modules/lighthouse/core/audits/audit.js';

export default class IntentionalAuditError extends Audit {
  static get meta() {
    return {
      id:'flighthouse-test-audit-error',
      title:'Weighted audit failure fixture',
      failureTitle:'Weighted audit failure fixture',
      description:'This test-only audit throws to capture a real Lighthouse partial-error result.',
      requiredArtifacts:[],
    };
  }
  static audit() {
    throw new Error('Intentional test-only audit failure');
  }
}
